description: Asynchronous buck, 12 V input, 50% duty at 100 kHz, PMOS high-side switch (Level 1), freewheel diode + 1 nF snubber, L = 10 uH, C = 100 uF, R_load = 6 Ohm. Output charges toward the ideal D*Vin = 6 V with LC startup dynamics (LC resonance ~5 kHz, load time constant 600 us).
physical_check: v_out is monotonic rising and stays below the ideal 6 V regulation point during startup
